title: Constructed cohomology restriction with tensor-composition coefficients
statement: For schemes A, B, C [def-pc-scheme], maps a:A→B, b:B→C, c:A→C with a≫b=c, a C-module G and a degree q, construct the ordinary module-cohomology map from H^q(B,b^*G) to H^q(A,c^*G) [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. Its coefficient map is the adjunct, under the fixed chosen tensor adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback], of the normalized tensor-composition isomorphism [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] followed by equality transport along a≫b=c. Name that coefficient-object equality and prove the defining equation. This is a construction of the existing canonical map, with no new choice.

source.place: Tags 01F8 and 01FB, coefficient maps on cohomology; descent.tex Tag 03DR, normalized tensor composition.

proof.text: Apply the tensor-pullback object function at G to the equality a≫b=c, obtaining the named equality of coefficient objects. Compose the normalized tensor-composition morphism with its equality transport; take its adjunct using the existing chosen tensor adjunction and apply moduleCohomologyFMap in degree q. The formula with the named equality proof is reflexivity. For the direct congrArg formula, use proof irrelevance to identify the equality proofs and apply congruence to the adjoint coefficient and cohomology construction before specializing any module. This works also for identity arrows, arbitrary q, and the zero coefficient module: no cancellation or geometric hypothesis is used.

lean.statement:
def tensorCompositeCohomologyRestriction {A B C : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ C) (c : A ⟶ C) (w : a ≫ b = c)
    (G : C.Modules) (q : ℕ) :
    AddCommGrpCat.of ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology B.toRingedSpace q).obj
      ((tensorPullback b).obj G)) ⟶
    AddCommGrpCat.of ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology A.toRingedSpace q).obj
      ((tensorPullback c).obj G))
